summary: Explore a designed lamp by moving its hinges within a declared motion envelope.
objective: Design a folding desk lamp with a weighted-looking base, two arms and a shade I can aim.
example_prompts: Design a folding desk lamp with a weighted-looking base, two arms and a shade I can aim.
Show hinge limits and a cable route through the lamp arms.

entities.name: Base and arms
entities.guidance: Model base shell, hinge clevises, arm links and visible axle caps.

entities.name: Shade and cable
entities.guidance: Use a hollow shade with diffuser recess; show a slack cable guide around hinges.

object_craft.structure: Model base shell, hinge clevises, arm links and visible axle caps.
object_craft.material: Powder-coated metal with polymer hinge caps.
object_craft.articulation: Axes pass through actual pin centers; each link has one parent.

object_craft.structure: Use a hollow shade with diffuser recess; show a slack cable guide around hinges.
object_craft.material: Satin shade and frosted diffuser; dark flexible-looking cable.
object_craft.articulation: Shade rotates at its neck; cable is an authored curve, not tension solved.

state_contract.model: Authored joint-angle vector, explicit angle bounds and evaluated rest hierarchy.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.

invariants: A rejected angle leaves the last valid pose unchanged.
Shade and base envelopes must not intersect in accepted presets.
motion_guidance: Interpolate valid joint angles; check intermediate poses rather than only endpoints.
A luminous diffuser needs actual configured lighting or an honest decorative emission label.
known_limits: No stability, spring torque, thermal, electrical or manufacturing certification.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Large readable hinges communicate adjustment and a warm diffuser emphasizes the aimed direction.

colliders: Conservative base, link and shade envelopes for pose rejection.
driving: User joint handles and bounded preset interpolation.
contact: Clearance checks only; no torque solver.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Fold sweep remains clear; rest dimensions remain fixed.
